title: hdial
description: `hdial` (also shown as `hdl`) is a horizontal GUI dial made of a configurable number of buttons that outputs the selected button’s numeric index, making it useful for choosing among discrete options. Its output can be sent through a named send symbol and dispatched with `route`, and messages such as `number`, `size`, `color`, and `single_change`/`double_change` configure its appearance and behavior.
